title: Deeper/broader versioned carrier, writer evidence, and DIMSTYLE subclass ambiguity review
mode: primary-source web research and plan refinement
scope: Cross-check DXF ACIS carrier version boundaries and peer loss reports
Audit the ACadSharp DIMSTYLE group-71/340 report against Autodesk references and source-visible writers
Reconcile malformed-input reports and FreeCAD converter/importer route with existing local plan owners
Refine existing PAR-07/S8 and PAR-120/7BQ.5 evidence and implementation-readiness gates

method.kind: Read official format references, current project source/docs/issues, and the local plan/source status
method.limitations: GitHub issues and mutable main/master pages are report/source snapshots, not independent runtime results. The ACadSharp #1253 attachment and customer DWG/DXF files were not downloaded. Autodesk's published DIMSTYLE record fields do not document every observed AcDbDimStyleTable subclass payload, so the local AC1024 header variant remains a version-scoped unqualified candidate. DWG byte-layout questions remain governed by the local ODA v5.4.1 specification.

sources.revision: Published Autodesk DXF references for 2020/2023, reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The 3DSOLID page documents legacy inline modeler data fields. Common symbol-table documentation describes group 70 as the table header's maximum-entry count. DIMSTYLE record documentation assigns record-level group 71 to DIMTOL and record-level group 340 to the referenced DIMTXSTY STYLE. These sources do not specify all later AcDbDimStyleTable subclass payload variants or modern ACDSDATA carrier details.

sources.revision: Stable documentation identifies version 1.4.5; documentation reviewed 2026-10-18, package not run
sources.observed: Documentation describes SAT in DXF R2000-R2010 and SAB/ACDSDATA in R2013/R2018 and warns that ACIS support is limited, with unsupported entities liable to be lost. It is a carrier/format route reference, not independent semantic evidence.

sources.revision: Issue report pins LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at 8a1ae764 on Linux/x86-64; page reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The report describes a source-authored DXF reproduction where a REGION shell survives conversion but 5,489 SAB bytes in R2013+ AcDs/ACDSDATA are lost. It also describes a confidential R2018 drawing that was not obtained. This is a report about the pinned peer build, not a libdxfrw reproduction or current-main result.

sources.revision: Issue report names ACadSharp 3.4.9; PR page reviewed open and not deployed on 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The issue reports DWG-to-DXF omission of 3DSOLID/REGION records, including block contents. Linked PR #1240 proposes ACIS writer support but is an unmerged branch, not a released peer baseline.

sources.project: ACadSharp issue #1253 and Autodesk DIMSTYLE references
sources.revision: Issue report measures ACadSharp 3.6.35 and describes AutoCAD 2027 testing; page reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The report claims a DIMSTYLE table-subclass group-71 count and table-level group-340 handle list. Autodesk references establish different record-level meanings and generic table-header group 70, but do not document the extra subclass payload. The report's raw output/hash was not independently obtained.

sources.project: QGIS, KiCad, and LibreCAD DXF output examples
sources.revision: QGIS mutable master page; KiCad source mirror package 10.0.6; LibreCAD repository drawing page; reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The inspected source/output examples differ in the extra AcDbDimStyleTable payload: QGIS emits the subclass with group 70 and no 71/340 header list; KiCad emits group 71=0; the LibreCAD drawing emits group 71=1 and record-scoped group 340. These are bounded observations and do not establish a version-complete normative rule.

sources.revision: Issue bodies describe version-specific ACadSharp reports; pages reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: Reports concern missing VERTEX subtype handling, locale-sensitive codepage lookup, recursive DXF sequence advancement/stack exhaustion, and a DWG-to-DXF spline complaint. Their thresholds, sample shape, and outcomes are not format rules or local defects; the #1299 customer attachment was not downloaded.

sources.revision: Mutable main/documentation pages reviewed 2026-10-18; no application run
sources.observed: The inspected stock workflow converts DWG to DXF through a selected external converter and then invokes FreeCAD's DXF importer. The route and selected importer must be recorded separately; documentation does not qualify current Linux/Windows output or stock ACIS/B-rep import.

assessment.planImpact: Reaffirms separate DWG inline, DWG AcDs, legacy DXF SAT, and modern DXF ACDSDATA/SAB routes; records peer writer omissions as version/direction-specific failure-mode leads; keeps the local AC1024 DIMSTYLE group-71/count and table-level group-340 output as EXTERNAL_ACCEPTANCE_PENDING because public DXF docs and observed implementations do not establish a complete versioned contract; keeps stock FreeCAD converter-to-DXF import distinct from ACIS semantics. Fast per-slice cadence and current local implementation order are unchanged.

implementationReadyChecks: Keep normal slices on the existing local fast loop: strict touched-target build, focused generated selector, owning CTest, relevant LibreCAD compatibility check, and scoped diff/receipt validation.

Do not change the local AC1024 DIMSTYLE special-header behavior based on issue prose alone; keep the existing generated wire census as a local serialization check and require exact-version producer evidence plus a strict consumer before qualification.
At the existing composed ACIS gate, compare entity identity and disposition, exact carrier bytes, owner/key linkage, and semantic/native results separately across the four existing carrier routes.
Keep parser robustness controls generated in memory or scratch; derive budgets from local policy and source contracts, not peer issue thresholds.

For FreeCAD, capture converter build/options, output DXF hash/version, selected importer backend/preferences, diagnostics, recovery, and per-object disposition; do not treat stock converter-to-DXF import as ACIS/B-rep evidence.
Do not download issue attachments or customer drawings, commit new external fixtures, or make optional peers a blocker for local implementation.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL until their specified external/platform and independent semantic evidence is independently available.
